name: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The classic World War II shooter, run on OpenMoHAA, the open-source engine. Installs the engine for the node's CPU and the game's data; add your settings to main/server.cfg.
startup: exec ./omohaaded +set dedicated 1 +set net_ip 0.0.0.0 +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set sv_hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +set sv_maxclients {{SERVER_MAXCLIENTS}} +set rconPassword "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +set g_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" +exec server.cfg +map {{SERVER_MAP}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Medal of Honor: Allied Assault. Runs on OpenMoHAA, the open-source engine
# (from its GitHub releases, checked against GitHub's SHA-256, for the
# node's CPU), with the game's data from LinuxGSM's server archive,
# downloaded once. main/server.cfg and added maps are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=openmoh/openmohaa
want="${OPENMOHAA_VERSION:-latest}"
data_url=http://linuxgsm.download/MedalofHonorAlliedAssault/moh_revival_v1.12_RC3.5.1.tar.xz
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
*) fail "OpenMoHAA has no Linux build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

# The engine.
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    tag="v${want#v}"
    gh-release tag "$repo" "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "OpenMoHAA has no release $tag. Set OpenMoHAA version to latest, or to a release such as v0.82.1."
fi
asset="openmohaa-$tag-linux-$arch.zip"
sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }') || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "OpenMoHAA $tag has no Linux build for $arch."
if [ -x omohaaded ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-openmohaa 2>/dev/null)" = "$asset $sum" ]; then
    echo "OpenMoHAA $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OpenMoHAA $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/engine.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q -o "$build/engine.zip" -d "$build/engine"
    [ -f "$build/engine/omohaaded" ] || fail "OpenMoHAA $tag has no dedicated server in its Linux build."
    cp -a "$build/engine/." /mnt/server/
    chmod +x omohaaded
    echo "$asset $sum" > .raptor-openmohaa
fi

# The game's data: Allied Assault's main folder, about 1.6 GB.
if [ -f main/Pak0.pk3 ] && [ -f main/Pak5.pk3 ]; then
    echo "The game data is already here."
else
    echo "Downloading the game data (2.9 GB; only Allied Assault's part is kept)"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/data.tar.xz" "$data_url" || fail "The game data's download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir "$build/data"
    tar -xJf "$build/data.tar.xz" -C "$build/data" --wildcards 'main/*' || fail "The game data didn't unpack. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -f "$build/data.tar.xz"
    [ -f "$build/data/main/Pak0.pk3" ] || fail "The game data is incomplete. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p main
    # Windows game libraries the engine doesn't use stay behind.
    rm -f "$build"/data/main/*.dll
    cp -rn "$build/data/main/." main/
fi

if [ ! -f main/server.cfg ]; then
    cat > main/server.cfg <<'CFG'
// Your server settings, run at every start. The name, players, passwords
// and first map are set from the Startup page.
seta g_gametype 1          // 1 free-for-all, 2 team deathmatch, 3 round-based, 4 objective
seta fraglimit 0
seta timelimit 20
seta sv_maplist "dm/mohdm1 dm/mohdm2 dm/mohdm3 dm/mohdm4 dm/mohdm5 dm/mohdm6 dm/mohdm7"
seta sv_gamespy 1
CFG
fi
echo "Installed OpenMoHAA $tag with Medal of Honor: Allied Assault's data."

variables.name: OpenMoHAA version
variables.description: The OpenMoHAA engine release to install, such as v0.82.1, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as dm/mohdm7 or obj/obj_team2.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password for rcon commands. Empty turns the remote console off.
